bio.text: Edgardo Baez is the Republican nominee in Texas's 20th Congressional District, according to the San Antonio Report, which describes him as a U.S. Army veteran, retired medical professional, lawyer and published author.

In a candidate questionnaire for the San Antonio Report, Baez said he lives in San Antonio, is a former Army combat medic, airborne paratrooper and drill sergeant and an intensive care unit nurse, and has worked as an attorney in San Antonio for 20 years.
